The build itself matches the brief: the gear-panel switch, the POST to `/api/session/settings`, the live line read from the server, the docs, and the test. I only read the diff and the code. I did not run the test.

- **[fix] 360×740 shot:** `assistants-360.png` isn't in the task folder as the brief asked. The test writes it into the older `dictation-debug/settings/shots/` folder.
- **[fix] No result note:** the task folder has no commit hash or test output, so a fresh agent would have only the diff to go on.
- **[note] Default line:** when the session has no word of its own, the live line says "Servex's default" without saying whether that means one or two assistants.
- **[note] Knobs reset:** each assistant change also re-sends the unset batch-seconds fields as `null`, which resets any value set on the server for that session.

I made no code edits.
